about: A realm's edits (edits.proto, GitHub #13250): the bodies that change a realm through coax/web/api/realms.c (a row switched, the visitors' tools and a thing placed are world edits since #13514, /api/worlds/SLUG: their routes and steps are gone), as the realm edit layer and My Realm send them (no revision) and as the CLI sends them under .../edit-v1/ (the revision first), with the status and body the server answers today. "rev" names the realm whose revision the body's "rev":41 stands for: the check reads it from the realm's spec, and the revision in the answer is the run's ("vary"). "bodies" are requests the planner's model answers (an ask, a revision, an ask marked done): only their bodies are held here. metaverse-engine/editor/change.coax writes every body; metaverse-engine/editor/change-goldens.coax holds them and the answers' keys; coax/web/api/tests/realm_record_checks.coax makes the calls.

realm.seed: INSERT INTO verse.players (id, key_sha256, created_ms) VALUES ('p-edit-fixture', encode(sha256(convert_to('edit-fixture-player-key-0001', 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1); INSERT INTO verse.worlds (id, owner_player, created_ms) VALUES ('made-edit-fixture', 'p-edit-fixture', 1); INSERT INTO verse.made_realms (slug, world, name, style, ground, time, features, tools, made_ms) VALUES ('edit-fixture', 'made-edit-fixture', 'Edit Fixture', 'lowpoly', 'grass', 'day', '[{"feature":"trees","variant":"pine","count":6},{"feature":"character","name":"Old Mott","role":"the ferryman"}]', '{"fly":true,"jump":true}', 1);
realm.clean: CREATE TEMP TABLE ef AS SELECT m.slug FROM verse.made_realms m JOIN verse.worlds w ON w.id = m.world WHERE w.owner_player = 'p-edit-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.realm_publications WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ef); DELETE FROM verse.realm_revisions WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ef); DELETE FROM verse.realm_proposals WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ef); DELETE FROM verse.realm_lore WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ef); DELETE FROM verse.realm_quests WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ef); DELETE FROM verse.made_realms WHERE slug IN (SELECT slug FROM ef); DELETE FROM verse.worlds WHERE owner_player = 'p-edit-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.players WHERE id = 'p-edit-fixture';
